## 🛠️ Projects
- **[Atrover](https://github.com/backyard-developers)** / A real-time rover control platform for Android-based rover clients. Remote control via web dashboard with live video and audio feeds. (Team project)

- **[Global Ctrl C + V](https://github.com/space-enthusiast/gcv)**  / Global clipboard synchronization service enabling seamless copy & paste across multiple devices. Built with **Kotlin + Ktor** (server), **HTMX** (frontend), and **Go CLI** for Windows & Linux support. (Team project)

- **[Anytype PDF Tag Remover](https://github.com/space-enthusiast/any-type-pdf-tag-remover)** / Cross-platform **GUI application** to analyze and remove Anytype-specific tags and metadata from exported PDF files.

- **[Drag to Summarize](https://github.com/space-enthusiast/summarizer)** / Minimal **Chrome Extension** that summarizes selected text using Chrome’s built-in **Summarizer API**.
